title: EnvSched: Environment-Aware Scheduling for Rollout-Efficient Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.37609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As executable environments for language agents scale, generating and verifying their rollouts becomes increasingly expensive. Under finite rollout budgets, this raises an important question: can data management at the environment level make agentic reinforcement learning (RL) more efficient by organizing, evaluating, and scheduling task instances together with the environments that determine their tools, states, transitions, and verification? To address this question, we introduce EnvSched (Environment-aware Scheduling), an online scheduler that learns from rollout history. EnvSched assigns scheduling value through two complementary modeling choices: exploitation prioritizes tasks likely to provide informative reward differences, while coverage spreads each batch across underobserved environments and interaction patterns. translated_title: EnvSched：面向高效Rollout智能体强化学习的环境感知调度
translated_abstract: 随着语言智能体可执行环境的规模不断扩大，生成和验证其rollout（轨迹采样）的成本变得日益高昂。在有限的rollout预算下，这引出了一个重要问题：能否通过环境层面的数据管理，将任务实例与决定其工具、状态、转移和验证的环境一起进行组织、评估和调度，从而使智能体强化学习更加高效？为了解决这一问题，我们提出了EnvSched（环境感知调度），一种从rollout历史中学习的在线调度器。EnvSched通过两种互补的建模方式来分配调度价值：利用策略优先选择那些可能提供有信息量的奖励差异的任务，而覆盖策略则将每个批次分散到观测不足的环境和交互模式中。EnvSched将环境-任务对组织为双关系图中的节点，其中环境内的边捕捉……
tldr: 本文提出EnvSched，一种从rollout历史中学习的环境感知在线调度器，通过利用策略（优先选择信息量大的任务）与覆盖策略（分散到观测不足的环境）相结合，在有限rollout预算下显著提升智能体强化学习的效率。
en_tdlr: EnvSched is an environment-aware online scheduler that improves the efficiency of agent reinforcement learning under finite rollout budgets by combining exploitation of informative tasks with coverage of underobserved environments in a dual-relation graph structure.
